records.title: The Illusion of Multi-Agent Advantage
records.reason: arXiv abstract: evaluates claims about multi-agent advantages using benchmark comparisons; this empirical study does not propose an inference optimization method.

records.title: TetherCache: Stabilizing Autoregressive Long-Form Video Generation with Gated Recall and Trusted Alignment
records.reason: The full text manages a fixed KV cache for autoregressive video diffusion, using sink/recent/memory regions and retrieval/alignment to improve long-rollout video quality. It is a real cache-management technique but operates on diffusion video latent frames, not LLM/VLM token KV caches, and its results emphasize quality rather than LLM serving efficiency; the lineage tie is weak and transferability unresolved.

records.title: Breaking the Tokenizer Barrier: On-Policy Distillation across Model Families
records.reason: arXiv abstract: cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation transfers model knowledge during training; this post-training technique does not optimize deployed inference.

records.title: On Advantage Estimates for Max@K Policy Gradients
records.reason: arXiv abstract: MaxPO studies policy-gradient advantage estimators for pass@K/max@K post-training objectives; its quadratic-time estimator is for training optimization, not model inference.

records.title: Self-Distilled Policy Gradient
records.reason: arXiv abstract: SDPG combines RL advantages, on-policy self-distillation and KL regularization to improve post-training; it is not an inference-time efficiency technique.
